    ON SELECT TO public.household_audit_ledger_entries DO INSTEAD  SELECT id,
    household_id,
    chain_key,
    chain_epoch,
    epoch_kind,
    sequence,
    previous_hash,
    entry_hash,
    hash_algorithm,
    schema_version,
